about: Reel-local pronunciation fixes for this film, in the toolkit's runtime/pronunciation format. Applied only to the text sent to Kokoro by voice.py. narration_text, the word clock and FACTCHECK are unchanged. Checked with Kokoro's phonemizer on 2026-10-14.

entries.note: In 'an NBA RAG app' Kokoro spelled R-A-G; lowercase 'rag' is the word (retrieval-augmented generation is said 'rag').
Default G2P said KAHM-yur-ee; 'Kommu-ree' gives KAHM-oo-ree. Siddi listened and confirmed it sounds right, 2026-10-14.
